title: Remove Group Wall
features:
• Auto Load
• Auto Remove Group Wall
• No Key
• Free
script:
local function bypassGroupDoor()
    for _, v in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if v.Name == "Group" then
            pcall(function()
                v.CanCollide = false
                v.Transparency = 1
            end)
        end
    end
end

bypassGroupDoor()

if queue_on_teleport then
    queue_on_teleport([[
        loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://pastefy.app/HLv7RtA9/raw", true))()
    ]])
end

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        bypassGroupDoor()
        task.wait(5)
    end
end)
